about: Everybody in the Okta organisation with their lifecycle status — active, suspended, deprovisioned — department, title and employee number: the list of who works here that every other tool is compared with, leavers included.

params.org: the organisation's subdomain: acme for acme.okta.com

credentials.okta-api-token: An API token made by an administrator holding the Read-Only Administrator role, and no other: an Okta API token can do whatever its maker can, so it must be made by an account that can only read.

manifest.name: okta
manifest.note: Okta's user list leaves out deprovisioned users unless asked, so leavers are read by an endpoint of their own. The next page is in the Link header, and is followed only to the organisation's own host.
